title: Food crises, forced displacement, and funding constraints
discussion_signal: The post links forced displacement, food insecurity, funding constraints, resilience, and the ability of displaced people to meet basic needs and build self-reliance. It supports the atlas claim that crises compound across conflict, displacement, climate, and response capacity.
linked_research_question: Where do conflict, displacement, climate shocks, and financing gaps compound into acute food crises?
limits: Event announcement is not outcome evidence
Institutional framing may emphasize program priorities
No independent estimate of crisis prevalence or intervention effect
